ingredientFacts: 4 cups all purpose white flour; plus a little more; source permits one third whole wheat
methodFacts: Activate yeast with sugar for 10–15 minutes; source phrase few tablespoons warm omits the liquid noun.
Mix flour, salt and activated yeast; if using add 1 tbsp butter; add water gradually and knead until cohesive, slightly sticky.
Punch down, knead a few minutes and shape.
Greased pan; rise 45–60 minutes; preheat 245 C.
Lower to 200 C; bake 35–45 minutes; rotate pan 180 degrees once; lower heat or cover with foil if needed.
Cool under wrung wet towel; optionally butter and wrap in a plastic bag for 20 minutes before serving.
